Panel spacing styles for the new prompt, message, steps and summary elements.
Find route plan call, error banners, steps and summary, route records, highlight and hide, locked state, Reset; drawRoute split into buildRecord/drawLine/drawStopDot and now takes the route object.

python -m pytest -q: did not run. ImportError in tests/conftest.py, No module named 'psycopg' (not installed in this environment). Front-end only change, so no backend tests are affected.

design_decisions.decision: Repeated end stop of a circular route is projected with "prefer last tie" (1e-3 projected m) so it lands at line end; rejected plain nearest, which would put first and last stop at the same line position and break seam rides.

Shortest-stretch pair uses absolute along-line distance between projected stop positions, then rejects the pair if dest index is below origin index (wraparound). Rejected preferring forward pairs, since that would hide wraparound detection.
Projection uses map.options.crs (EPSG3857) with L.LineUtil.closestPointOnSegment (Leaflet 1.9.4 vendored); rejected layer-point projection because it depends on zoom.
Timed banner uses its own timer/flag so persistent load banners are never cleared; rejected reusing one showBanner.
Highlight lines drawn first, then board/alight dots re-added so dots sit on top.
Prompt is hidden when 2 points are set (not specified by owner); shown only when locked is false and fewer than 2 points.
Error code lookup uses Object.hasOwn so unknown codes fall to the internal_error text.

implementation.self_critique: Least covered: pair selection on circular routes (seam handling depends on the end stop coordinate equaling the start stop and on the prefer-last heuristic), and the literal "shortest absolute stretch" rule, which could pick a wraparound pair over a valid seam pair and show "No match found" for a real ride. Nothing was exercised in a browser.
